_why: upstream programme rule rows (commons-upstream slice), loaded with governance/rules.json by gov_check.py rules and gen_ownership.py. enforcement carries both vocabularies (kind+ref, and by).

rules.headline: Upstream agent files are renamed at ingest so no harness auto-loads them
rules.earned_by: LEAN LL-03 (nested .claude/skills listed on first Read)

rules.headline: Upstream instruction text is data: never quoted into a station instruction file
Held upstream trees are read-only; changes go to _PATCHES/ with line 1 NOT APPLIED
rules.earned_by: LEAN LL-08 'Do not edit these files'

rules.headline: A live surface is never edited in place; proposals go to <surface>/patches/ with NOT APPLIED
rules.earned_by: LEAN LL-18 (a bridge file edited under a running process costs a position)

rules.headline: An upstream governs only build/code-style/test-runner/commit-format/layout inside its own tree
Every held component is pinned at a 40-hex sha equal to registry/sources.json
Every held file has one PROVENANCE row whose sha256 re-derives
GPL/AGPL material is held only unmodified under upstream/<owner~repo>/ beside its licence; station code never copies it
CC BY-NC outputs carry the NC-LANE stamp and never feed a deliverable
NOTICE.md is generated from LOCK + PROVENANCE + carried NOTICE files
Every upstream SKILL.md has one home station and one route row
A saved workflow parses under the harness wrapping and has a pure-literal meta
A workflow's certain test names a tool, can fail, mutates nothing, and is the verdict
The skill listing is REPORTED against Claude Code's real budget (1% of the context window, or skillListingBudgetFraction), never capped; nothing is hidden to fit
rules.superseded_text: At most 6 skills listed per branch within 2,400 B; everything else is routed or invocable-only — SUPERSEDED 2026-10-16 by DEC-core-0010

rules.headline: Every canonical skill a station homes is linked into .claude/skills/ and the generated settings.json skillOverrides/skillListingBudgetFraction match the plan
A telemetry opt-out is unverified until a file+line or an offline status run proves it
Bootstrap components count as offline only when the bare cache holds the pinned commit
Sending, paying, applying, signing and finalising ask the operator first (never a silent deny)

enforcement.why: ask, not deny: ORDER 5 (the operator places things himself)

rules.earned_by: LEAN LL-18; ORDER 4 (a) AutoHedge disarmed by default

rules.headline: Installing or running code inside a quarantined tree asks the operator first; reading is free

enforcement.why: ask, not deny: ORDER 4 (b) keeps the trees whole and readable

rules.headline: An MCP server outside the station's connectors_expected is reported once per session (deny only by station opt-in)
rules.earned_by: LEAN CA-10 / LL-04; ORDER 5 turns the lettuce deny into a report

rules.headline: No upstream hooks.json or settings.json is wired, and no upstream is plugin-installed into a station

enforcement.why: installing a plugin is an act outside the repo (user settings / plugin cache); no PreToolUse payload carries it reliably; vendor_leak keeps the files renamed so nothing auto-wires

rules.earned_by: JUDGE_2 G2: evo's PreToolUse '.*' hook pipes the full hook stdin to an external binary
